title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition & Operations
description:
HR Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations

**Company:** Pioneer Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| In\-Office  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years

**Job Overview**

Pioneer Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an HR **Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations** with strong hands\-on experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end hiring across technical, sales, and corporate functions while also handling core HR activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage **end\-to\-end recruitment** from understanding requirements to candidate joining.
* Source candidates through **LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, referrals, and other channels**.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
* Screen, shortlist, and assess candidates based on role fit and organisational requirements.
* Coordinate interviews and work closely with hiring managers for timely closures.
* Manage candidate engagement, follow\-ups, offer negotiations, and joining conversions.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring MIS.
* Develop sourcing strategies for specialised and difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Manage onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave, and HR records.
* Support payroll coordination, employee engagement, HR policies, and other HR processes.

**Requirements**

* **3–5 years of HR experience** with strong hands\-on experience in **Recruitment/Talent Acquisition**.
* Proven experience in end\-to\-end hiring and candidate sourcing.
* Experience in hiring for **IT/Technology, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Sales, or specialised roles** will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of LinkedIn and major job portals.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong ownership, follow\-up, and target\-oriented approach.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS/recruitment tools.
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.

**Why Join Pioneer Technologies?**

* Opportunity to take ownership of recruitment across multiple business functions.
* Exposure to **IT, Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, Sales, and other business verticals**.
* Direct interaction with management and hiring teams.
* Opportunity to grow with an established and expanding organisation.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Placement Manager – Engineering
description:
Placement Manager – Engineering

**Experience:** 5\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for an experienced **Placement Manager – Engineering** to drive campus placements and build strong relationships with leading companies. The candidate will be responsible for generating placement opportunities, managing recruiter relationships, and coordinating the end\-to\-end placement process for engineering students.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate recruiters and industry partners.
* Drive campus placement and recruitment activities for engineering students.
* Identify and onboard new companies for placements and internships.
* Coordinate recruitment drives, interviews, assessments, and offer processes.
* Work closely with students and internal teams to ensure placement readiness.
* Track placement data, targets, and recruitment outcomes.

**Requirements:**

* 5\+ years of experience in placements, corporate relations, recruitment, or talent acquisition.
* Experience in an engineering/technical education environment preferred.
* Strong corporate network and excellent communication skills.
* Strong negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a target\-driven environment.

Pay: ₹726,876\.81 \- ₹1,220,922\.90 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in campus placements/corporate relations?
* Do you have experience handling placements for engineering/technical students?
* Have you independently onboarded new companies for campus placements?
* What is your current/most recent CTC?
* What is your notice period?
* Interviews will be conducted F2F (Face\-to\-Face). Please apply only if you are comfortable attending an in\-person interview at our location.

Work Location: In person

title: IT Recruiter – Noida Location
description:
**IT Recruiter – Noida Location Shift Timings:** 1\-10PM IST 5 days Work from Office
  
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced IT Recruiter to manage full\-cycle recruitment activities across multiple business functions. In this role, you will collaborate closely with hiring managers to develop and implement effective sourcing strategies that attract, engage, and hire top\-tier, diverse talent. This is a dynamic and fast\-paced environment that encourages innovation and creative problem\-solving. The primary focus will be on delivering high\-quality hires, providing an exceptional candidate experience, and building strong, trusted partnerships with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
  
**Key Responsibilities:** The primary responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to: • Partner with your reporting manager to understand workforce requirements, hiring priorities, and recruitment objectives for each position. • Develop and publish job postings across various channels, including job boards, social media platforms, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and other sourcing avenues. • Stay informed on current recruiting trends, assessment methodologies, and best practices to support effective candidate evaluation. • Establish and nurture strong relationships with hiring managers to understand ongoing and future talent needs, while aligning recruitment strategies with business objectives. • Leverage job boards, professional networks, social media, and other sourcing platforms to proactively identify and engage qualified talent. • Manage the entire talent acquisition lifecycle, from sourcing and screening through hiring, onboarding, and contributing to employee retention efforts. • Review resumes, conduct candidate assessments and interviews, coordinate interview schedules, and facilitate offer discussions and negotiations. • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of both active and passive candidates through continuous relationship management. • Utilize a variety of sourcing techniques and innovative recruitment strategies to attract high\-quality candidates across diverse roles. • Maintain accurate candidate records and ensure recruiting data is updated within the ATS and related systems. • Track, analyze, and report key recruitment metrics, identifying challenges and implementing improvement initiatives to enhance hiring effectiveness. • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations while promoting recruitment best practices.
  
Qualifications, Skills \& Experience • 4 to 7 years of proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment processes. • Demonstrated experience recruiting for Technology and IT technical positions. • Strong background in both niche skill hiring and high\-volume recruitment environments. • Experience promoting employer branding initiatives through LinkedIn and other social media platforms to enhance talent attraction. • In\-depth expertise in sourcing strategies, including technical and specialized talent acquisition. • Solid understanding of social media recruitment tools and networking platforms. • Proven success in candidate sourcing, talent mapping, market intelligence, stakeholder management, and offer negotiations. • Ability to perform effectively in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines. • Strong interviewing and assessment capabilities, with sufficient technical aptitude to support hiring for IT and technology\-related roles. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional presence. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, recruitment analytics, and reporting.
  
Preferred Candidate Profile • Strategic and results\-driven talent acquisition professional with strong stakeholder management skills. • Skilled in building talent pipelines and maintaining long\-term candidate relationships. • Data\-driven recruiter with the ability to leverage hiring metrics to improve recruitment outcomes. • Adaptable, proactive, and capable of managing both specialized and volume hiring requirements. • Passionate about delivering an exceptional candidate experience while supporting business growth through effective talent acquisition.
